Both feed stop-gradient encoder features to the actor; the encoder learns from reconstruction, with an annealed value head in Render.

Both feed stop-gradient encoder features to the actor; the encoder learns from reconstruction, with an annealed value head in Render.

basis.innovation: Applies SuperMimic-style world-model policy learning (an MLP world model refit online, backpropagation through imagined rollouts, a TD(λ) critic and weight averaging) to the LEAP Hand in mjlab / MuJoCo Warp, next to PPO baselines on the same environments: palm-up cube yaw, SO(3) cube reorientation (PPO only) and palm-down fingertip rotation of 22 objects, on a servo model identified on the real hand.
